Product Manager, Consumer

Anthropic · San Francisco, CA / New York City, NY · Senior


ROLE SUMMARY

Looking for a former consumer founder who deeply understands what makes experiences intuitive and indispensable, spikes on 0-to-1 product development, ships things people tell their friends about, and dives into everything to bring the vision to life.

Team / product: Consumer team at Anthropic — building AI that millions of people use every day to think better, create more, and accomplish what matters to them.


QUALIFICATIONS

- Track record as a founder OR 8+ years in product management with launch + scale experience.
- Can't stop thinking about new ways to build products on top of the latest model capabilities.
- Deep technical background; experience working cross-functionally with engineering teams to ship technical products.
- Ability to navigate ambiguity and flex into different domains; finds simple, easy-to-understand solutions.
- Experience launching ambitious consumer products that found distribution or commercial success.
- Thinks creatively about risks/benefits of new technologies, beyond past playbooks.
- Stays up-to-date and hands-on with emerging research and industry trends.
- Prototypes with AI tools like Claude Code.


RESPONSIBILITIES

- Work with researchers to understand what's emerging and what it means for users.
- Identify nascent research capabilities that could become transformative consumer products.
- Lead 0-to-1 product development from research to internal prototypes to shipped products.
- Define product strategy for consumer initiatives that push beyond current offerings.
- Creatively build MVPs and prototypes to validate PMF with the lowest cost possible.
- Lead vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution of frontier technologies.
